S: S_G = RDGs of the sealed frame G whose primary entry's platform/journey surface is RESOLVED_ELIGIBLE under decision-protocol.json (I0-I4 agreed TRUE; E1-E4, E6, T1-T3 agreed FALSE; >= 1 category agreed TRUE; no fatal stop; no deviation; records about the primary entry only)
primary_estimand: P_A1 is the equal-weight mean, over resolved-eligible registrable-domain groups represented in the frozen APIs.guru snapshot, of the probability that a fresh autonomous run PROVEN_SUCCEEDs on the platform/journey surface mechanically represented by that group's primary entry, given a valid determinate run, under the frozen Freeze-1 natural customer condition, journey, verifier and outcome taxonomy.
design: S0: the selected RDGs are the first min(24, M_G) members of S_G in the sealed uniform permutation of G, a simple random sample without replacement from S_G with inclusion probability n/M_G (amendment §7 proof)
estimator: for each selected RDG g: r_g = PROVEN_SUCCESS runs / valid determinate runs among its k = 5 attempts (UNKNOWN and invalid runs excluded from the denominator, never converted to failures); P_A1_hat = mean of r_g over selected RDGs with >= 1 valid determinate run (= (1/n) sum r_g when all are defined); indeterminate RDGs reported and bounded

uncertainty.primary: Freeze-1.1 §8.6 conservative two-stage band with one stratum over n = 24 RDG clusters: W = 1, C = 1/n_selected, e = sqrt(C ln 40); L_g = U_g = r_g if n_g > 0 else L_g = 0, U_g = 1
uncertainty.statement: At n = 24 the conservative band has half-width about 0.39 before indeterminate-vendor widening. A1 does not provide narrow population precision.
uncertainty.secondary: descriptive cluster bootstrap: 10,000 resamples of the selected RDGs; seed SHA256(canonical JSON ["FIRSTCALL-A1-BOOTSTRAP", sealed_sample_digest]); Freeze-1.1 §8.6 stream and nearest-rank rules otherwise unchanged
uncertainty.run_level: Freeze-1 Wilson intervals for per-platform and pooled run rates unchanged
uncertainty.correlation_limitation: SRS makes the SELECTION exchangeable, not the outcomes independent. Selected RDGs that share a control plane, vendor or infrastructure may have correlated run outcomes (e.g. a shared outage or shared documentation). The band's run-noise stage assumes cluster independence conditional on the frozen environment; where shared control planes exist that assumption may fail and the band may under-cover. This is reported as a limitation; no adjustment, collapsing or reweighting is made.

post_selection_non_executable: a selected RDG whose primary-entry surface cannot be executed (e.g. signup-time terms or KYC surfaced only after selection) is sealed SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTABLE, never replaced, contributes n_g = 0 (indeterminate) and widens the band via L_g = 0, U_g = 1
reported_separately: unresolved screening rate (identity and eligibility) with hypergeometric CI
number of keys, hosts and spec files per selected RDG (descriptive)
number screened T to obtain n, and (n-1)/(T-1) S-prevalence
descriptive category mix and per-category rates of selected platforms (INCOMPLETE vectors shown as such)
descriptively reported cross-domain relationships among selected RDGs (no estimator)
RDG frame size |G| and singleton RDG count by basis
forbidden_headlines: any claim about all API vendors, SaaS or software
any product of S-prevalence and success rate presented as a headline
category-weighted or pooled cross-population rates not separately preregistered
any vendor-level, vendor-collapsed or de-duplicated estimate
describing an RDG as a vendor
exhaustion: if the whole RDG permutation is exhausted with M_G < 24, all M_G members of S_G are selected (a complete census of S_G); if M_G < 16 A1 is reported as underpowered/uninformative under this criterion; no other population is substituted

multi_population.architecture: Programme A is a multi-population programme. A1 is the first registered population. Later populations (A2, A3, ...) may use other independently defined enumerations under the same Freeze-1 measurement standard, each with its own prospectively registered source, snapshot, unit rule, estimand and interval.
multi_population.pooling: none automatically; any pooled estimand needs a separately preregistered superpopulation (union frame, cross-population identity, multiplicity for overlapping platforms, declared weights) before any member population's outcomes are seen
multi_population.replication: consistency of per-population estimates and preregistered contrasts across differently constructed populations is replication/generalisation evidence about robustness to frame construction; it is never a licence for universal representativeness

unit_statement: An RDG is a structural sampling unit, not a vendor.
One vendor/control plane may contribute multiple RDGs.
One RDG may contain multiple products/platform surfaces.
Only the mechanically chosen primary entry is measured.
A1 does not estimate a universal vendor, API or SaaS success rate.
cross_domain_relationships: If two selected RDGs are shown by the ordinary frozen evidence process to share a vendor or control plane, BOTH are kept and measured as distinct units. This is a property of the A1 structural population, not a sampling error. Such relationships may be reported descriptively only and never alter inclusion, weighting, denominators, the primary estimate, replacement or eligibility. No vendor-collapsed or vendor-level estimator is defined or permitted.
